products.name: Classic Safety Razor
products.description: A perfect blend of traditional shaving with modern precision,this premium double-edged razor features a weighted metal handle for superior control and gravity-assisted action that requires no extra pressure. The three-part design can be used with all standard blades and assembles effortlessly. Perfect for clean shaves, styling sideburns, and creating sharp beard lines, this razor offers enhanced safety and performance. features: 1 Stroke Effortless Shaving
Life Lasting Metal Body
Gravity- Assisted Shaving
Versatile Styling
Comes with Protective Sheath

detailed_information.about_the_product: The Classic Safety Razor from Bombay Shaving Company is a piece of art and craftsmanship in the space of double-edged razors. It lets you experience the traditional close shaves, with a bolder and safer build than ever before, providing extra precision and protection while shaving. It is a fully collapsible design with three parts - a metal handle, a clamp and a razor head. Its weighted metal handle offers a non-slippery hold with complete control for a confident glide. It works on gravity-assisted action, so no extra pressure is required while shaving. It is compatible with all types of standard blades. All you have to do is unscrew the handle by twisting it to separate the top clamp and the base plate. Insert any double-edged blade of any brand and reassemble the razor effortlessly by placing the base plate over the blade; screw in the handle to close the razor tightly, and it’s ready to explore new styles. It is an eco-friendly razor, engineered for different purposes like flawless clean shaves, edgy sideburns and strong beard lines to create your desired look. The complimentary Protective Sheath makes it easier to store and helps increase the life of your razor by protecting it from physical damage.
how_to_use: Pull the razor handle to unscrew its metal handle
Place the blade carefully between the clamp and the razor head
Screw it back tightly and hold the razor at a 30-degree angle to your face
Start shaving in the direction of your beard hair growth
For the perfect close shave, go for short and firm glides

detailed_information.about_the_product: The Switch4 cartridge fits seamlessly onto your 3-blade handle. Switch4 is a 4-blade system that captures more hair with each pass, reducing the number of strokes needed and minimising skin irritation. The blades are precision-engineered to work progressively — each one lifting the hair slightly higher before the next cuts it closer, delivering a shave that feels effortless. The Dual Lubricating Strip is a meaningful step forward. Unlike a single strip that works in one direction, Switch 4's dual strip works both ahead of and behind the blade path — so your skin is prepared before the blades arrive and soothed immediately after they pass. The Pivot Head keeps all four blades in constant, even contact with your face as you navigate jawlines, the upper lip, and the neck — areas where flat-head razors tend to miss or drag. For those who style as they shave, the Back Blade offers precise control for defining beard edges, shaping a moustache, or cleaning up around sideburns — a feature most cartridges simply don't offer. EasyRinse Technology means the blade architecture stays open and unblocked, so a quick tap or rinse under the tap clears the cartridge completely — no clogging, no buildup, no wasted strokes. Each Switch4 cartridge is built to last up to 15 shaves, so you're not replacing blades as often as you might think. Better performance, longer lasting, and priced lower than what you're currently spending- that's what makes it Sensi!
how_to_use: Snap the Switch4 cartridge onto your 3-blade handle until you hear it click into place.
Rinse your face with warm water to soften the hair and open pores.
Apply shaving cream or foam to the area you want to shave.
Glide Switch4 gently across your skin in the direction of hair growth, using short, light strokes.
Rinse the cartridge under running water after every 2–3 strokes to keep blades clear.
For precision styling, flip the razor and use the Back Blade to define edges or shape facial hair.
Rinse your face with cool water after shaving and pat dry.
Store the razor in a dry place to extend blade life.

Go top to bottom and from side inwards while trimming
